description: Cuts the person out of one of the user's photos, paid from their credits: on a clear (transparent) backdrop unless backdrop names a colour, #rrggbb (the app offers #ffffff, #e9e7e3, #3a3a3c, #000000, #1f2f4d, #bcd7ee, #f2e8d5, #b9c8b0). On a photo that is already a cutout it lays it on another backdrop. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: remove_background
title: Remove a photo's background
